coverage.note: This visual helper is mounted under both error-banner hit targets in the transcript tests. Dismissal routing is tested, not every tint/message/width combination.
Detailed error-banner visual appearance, long-message wrapping and all callers have no independent pixel assertions.

Injected connection phases assert exact disconnected/connecting/provisioning/reconnecting status text, absent ready/error status, and bounded rendered presentation across narrow portrait and landscape fixtures. No real connection or pixel/animation acceptance is implied.
Every activity/orb animation branch, visual appearance and live connection timing remain outside these focused layout assertions.
Wheel input releases follow on the transcript and is contained by modal drawer paths. This is rendered GPUI event routing, not native momentum.
Native pan velocity, interactive keyboard dismissal and simultaneous system gesture arbitration need device checks.
Jump-to-latest and both visible/empty error banners are tapped in offline rendered fixtures; local follow and draft state are asserted.

Modeled transcript fixtures check narrow viewport layout and first-painted-frame anchoring during streamed growth, thinking/responding transitions, footer removal, resize and warmed-history jump/append. transcript-activity is a noninteractive measurement selector. No real socket responses or physical iOS frame pacing are covered.
Rendered windowed transcript compares non-windowed reference bounds and scroll extent after modeled offsets, edits, resize and a large jump. Direct offsets are not native scrolling acceptance.

Active-session wrapper delegates to render_composer_for; send/stop and metadata routing are exercised through this wrapper. Parked preview is separately tested and inertness is not inferred from active controls.
Native keyboard, socket acknowledgment and every simultaneous metadata/voice transition remain outside these offline fixtures.

Rendered send/stop controls cover readiness, blank drafts, local send/queued interrupt and stop-request state. Model/account/location metadata paths preserve drafts. The effort pill is a decorative label with no event handler. No socket is present.
Voice completion results are injected. Native capture and transcription upload are not performed.
Every simultaneous metadata/voice gesture combination and native recording cancellation timing are not independently covered.

The rendered Cancel dictation button is touched repeatedly across synthetic starting/busy voice flags; cancellation clears flags/status and preserves Unicode draft, tab and transcript. No Recording or microphone is acquired.

Stop and send is hit-tested with a synthetic locked startup. It releases gesture ownership, remembers stop during startup, and preserves the unrelated draft. No microphone or transcription service is acquired.
Rendered assistant text, reasoning and tool fixture content checks phone constraints; this function delegates interactive tools to tool_line.
All role, empty reasoning, error, markdown and streaming-content visual branches are not exhaustively snapshot tested.

Rendered header menu/tab controls, raw held-tab scrubbing and the new-session button are exercised. New-session is inert without an account, creates a new tab when signed in, and parks/restores the original draft.
Every overflow width, mouse-up ordering, accessibility tab activation and multi-pointer hold interleaving remains outside focused assertions.

Rendered model selection, same choice, scrim dismiss and unavailable/available routes are hit-tested. The metadata regression asserts a reachable row overlaps underlying account metadata at large text and closes without click-through reopening.
Actual provider availability and model change acknowledgment need an authorized live session.
Controls are scrolled into the phone viewport before raw input. New/clear/delete guard/sign-out behavior is asserted locally, not actual deletion execution.
Account deletion confirmation/service execution, persistent account removal and native account linking require isolated integration checks.

Settled Settings fixtures assert New/Clear/Link/Sign-out/Delete action bounds remain inside320/390-point phone widths. This distinguishes a moving seeded push transition from persistent overflow, not text/pixel or every content branch acceptance.
Use-other-email and outside-focus dismissal are exercised through the rendered sign-in surface; authentication results themselves are injected.
Provider layout and browser cancellation/late-completion identity are fixture assertions. These do not prove provider button success.
Google OAuth browser launch/return, email code delivery/verification and native keyboard/provider permissions need device or service checks.
Actual email/code validation, authentication startup readiness and live provider outcomes remain outside the offline early-return fixture.

Rendered submit is touched for seven email/code/busy fixture states and use-other-email is activated when available. Assertions prove offline early-return isolation and reset only, not validation readiness, real auth startup or provider success.
Email/code fields receive pointer focus, typed fixture text and Return; Submit event is counted and raw outside touch dismisses focus. Authentication remains guarded offline.

Rendered tab actions cover switch, close others, disabled fork and rename routes with local state. Row helper IDs describe control families, not every runtime tab instance. Actual overlapping metadata/header points, direct dismiss, synthetic clipboard copy, disabled last-close and active-close preserving another tab draft are also exercised.
Enabled remote fork, native clipboard ownership, OS hold recognition and every destructive-close interleaving remain unverified.
A rendered tool row is tapped twice and visible output expansion/collapse is asserted. Tool IDs are a runtime family, not one static instance per tool.
Every tool status, tool ID collision and long-output nesting combination is not independently exercised.
Screen roots are rendered during sign-in, chat sheets and settings tests; outside input and focus/overlay transitions exercise representative root routing.
Native safe-area/rotation/keyboard timing, application activation, VoiceOver and all three-screen interleavings require additional device checks.

Actual rendered keyboard keys/suggestions and Return feed the real MobileApp focused TextInput bridge for composer, drawer search, directory, email/code, rename, transfer and Apple-link email fixtures. Unicode drafts remain field-local and blank keyboard taps preserve focus. Drawer layering is tested through actual key taps, not direct sim_key calls. Return intent is observed offline, not server/provider acknowledgement.
Shared labels appear in constrained transcript/footer fixtures that assert bounds and layout. No assertion establishes every label caller, font or accessibility behavior.
All shared-label content/color/scale combinations are not independently snapshotted.

Injected connection phases assert exact disconnected/connecting/provisioning/reconnecting status text, absent ready/error status, and bounded rendered presentation across narrow portrait and landscape fixtures. No real connection or pixel/animation acceptance is implied.
Every activity/orb animation branch, visual appearance and live connection timing remain outside these focused layout assertions.
Shared outline-button IDs/selector plumbing is exercised indirectly by rendered settings controls. This does not prove every caller or disabled variant.
Dynamic model row ID/selector families are exercised by routed and unavailable model fixtures. Every provider/model combination is not enumerated.

Shared pill IDs/selector plumbing is exercised by model/account picker routes; location uses a separate control. Effort is a decorative label, while voice cancel and every other caller remain separate coverage obligations.

The actual paint polygon generator is checked against independent circle radius, mirrored corners, viewport bounds and mask area across 1,024 seeded translated viewport sizes; empty/nonfinite geometry is rejected. These are vertices used by painting, not GPU/pixel assertions.
Rasterization, antialiasing, stacking above every overlay and screenshot corner appearance still need visual acceptance.
Rendered composer send/stop uses the shared round control. This covers representative caller states rather than every icon/button invocation.
Apple button bounds and provider ordering are inspected on phone layouts, without invoking native authorization.
Apple authentication button launch, entitlement, consent, cancellation and returned account credentials need a native device/bridge run.
Settings/account fixtures render the app integration and reject a different account identity. Native account authorization is not performed.
Every parent-app mount/unmount transition while a link panel event is pending is not individually hit-tested.
Panel controls link-account/link-submit/link-cancel are driven through raw rendered touch. Service successes/failures are fake completions with generation checks.
Real link-email delivery, verification and subscription merge/persistence need an authorized service run.
Offline settings rendering and setup-draft content/preservation are checked. These tests do not execute the cloud inspection service or prove both button hit routes.
Cloud inspection SSH, GitHub auth setup and real credential storage are deliberately excluded and require approved integration steps.
Global URL channel installation and native Shortcut donation are intentionally not invoked by offline tests. Real cold/warm OS URL delivery needs an application-level native run.
Direct parsed-link dispatch covers signed-out no-op, active/parked reuse, fresh tab/prompt replacement and deferred local dispatch readiness. No URL channel or network is used.
Delivery before application channel installation, native cold-start lifecycle and actual server receipt of a queued prompt remain integration requirements.
Commit and overview frame bounds are asserted at 320, 390 and 430 points with populated and empty injected snapshots. No pixel, clipping or real repository acceptance is implied.
Exact frame borders, colors, text clipping and device Dynamic Type combinations have no independent pixel assertions.
Rows render in the populated Git card fixture, but individual row layout, truncation, status tint and per-row pixel output are not asserted.
The rendered more-commits control is clicked after narrow-width frame checks; the expansion flag and unchanged composer draft are asserted with an injected snapshot.
Collapse-after-expand, individual commit pixels, large real histories and authenticated SSH results are not independently verified.
The rendered more-files control is clicked and expansion plus composer preservation asserted. A clean injected snapshot then verifies that the control disappears.
Collapse-after-expand, all status/diff-stat visual combinations, real repository completion and device presentation remain unverified.
Rendered Git handle supports raw touch pull and tap; short/horizontal/cancelled pulls remain inert and context changes dismiss stale content.
Device touch arbitration and a real authenticated repository inspection are not exercised.

Panel close/reopen and scroll containment at panel/header boundaries are exercised offline without changing transcript/follow/voice state. Raw overlap points verify modal ownership; rendered Refresh and Done are reached within the real panel clip using offline fixture state.
Refresh generation/context/account invalidation and sanitized errors use injected Git snapshots/results, not real SSH.
Large populated remote Git snapshots, real SSH refresh completion and every scroll/content combination remain unverified.
Raw message hold resolves the actual recorded message bounds, opens the menu and cancels subsequent contact without mutating transcript/draft.
Every message hit-boundary, overlapping tool row and long-content geometry is not independently covered.
Model picker fixtures mount this geometry recorder while selecting/dismissing the real rendered sheet. The recorder has no separate direct shape assertion.
Every drag-dismiss threshold, changing model-list height and keyboard/sheet collision needs more focused geometry assertions.
Held-tab and tab-menu tests use rendered recorded tab bounds for scrub/hold/release behavior.
All tab overflow, touch-id reuse and mixed mouse/touch boundary cases are not enumerated.
A rendered transcript wheel pull is armed and cancelled; reconnect must not occur. This tests representative routing through the recorded transcript geometry.
Refresh ownership and voice pending-result navigation use state seams; they do not prove every rendered indicator phase.
All voice/reconnect indicator visual states and native simultaneous momentum/keyboard dismiss combinations lack focused visual evidence.
Representative raw mouse/touch capture, held tab, cancellation, rename and scene transition routes exercise wrapper routing. Static on_mouse_event counts are not every possible gesture interleaving.
Voice gesture ownership is seeded without real Recording objects. Native capture startup and interruptions require device checks.
Hold menu copy/retry/select/dismiss routes use rendered input, preserve draft/transcript, and gate retry locally.
The share action opens a native share sheet and actual clipboard ownership needs platform checks. No fixture claim covers native sharing.
Rendered rename save/cancel and submit paths cover empty/unicode title, focus release and modal transient cleanup at settled keyboard viewports.
Live keyboard animation/interactive dismissal and server rename acknowledgment remain platform/service requirements.
Rendered read-only selection, copy and Done routes reject edits and release focus while preserving the transcript and draft.
Native iOS selection handles, copy menu and accessibility activation are not GPUI fixture coverage.
Invisible canvas bounds are used indirectly by mounted gesture/sheet fixtures. No standalone test exhaustively asserts recorded geometry across layout changes.
Stale bounds after every viewport/rotation change and callback ordering have no independent recorder regression.
The fixture explicitly resizes to a wide 1024px layout and taps docked quick actions before returning to phone width.
Every tablet/desktop breakpoint, sidebar focus route, rotation and keyboard-width combination is not covered by that single wide fixture.

Rendered offline neighboring panel compares saved-scroll message and multiline composer bounds against the destination and preserves draft/tool/follow state. This is geometry/state evidence, not pixel equivalence.
Clicks inside the neighboring panel must not expand tools, send, focus either editor or change parked scroll/draft state.
Every transcript role/reasoning combination, native swipe delivery and transition-frame pixels remain unverified.
Wheel movement, cancellation and Ended over the inert neighboring shield continue the shared swipe exactly once; cancelled gestures cannot idle-commit.

Directory row/go/dismiss controls are hit-tested for invalid, same and valid fixture paths and a recent-row selection. Raw overlapping header/metadata contacts verify sheet ownership, with actual directory-list clip reachability.
Real remote directory discovery/validation and connection changes need service integration.
Directory input is pointer-focused and receives routed select-all, typed path and Return/Go, asserting trimmed directory change without transport.
Active-session wrapper delegates to render_recent_dirs_for. Directory/session suggestion routing is hit-tested offline, not a live service response.
Rendered directory suggestions navigate offline fixtures. Right-edge new-session creation skips the directory sheet and preserves the previous tab draft.
Empty/missing metadata and suggestion ordering use local data models, not a live service response.
The compact account footer is tapped to open Settings and close the drawer. Layout assertions check its phone placement.
Drawer list, pinned areas and scrim contain wheel input without transcript scroll/follow changes; navigation tests exercise its visible controls.
Every scrim down/up ordering, native momentum and simultaneous drawer/edge gesture race is not covered.
Drawer search text is supplied synthetically with set_text, then rendered filtering and result-row selection are checked. This does not hit-test keyboard editing or the search input itself.
Native IME, every caret/selection position and search interruption/momentum combination remain unverified.

The actual search field is pointer-focused, receives routed typed text and Home/Delete, filters fixture results and opens the matching result without transport. Native IME/keyboard rendering is not exercised.
Dynamic drawer-tab and close families are exercised by selecting and closing rendered open-tab rows in the offline phone UI.
Every last-tab/active-tab/overflow ordering and native accessibility close action is not exhaustively represented.
Rendered drawer new-thread and refresh controls are reachable and exercised. Offline refresh cannot prove a live service request.

Rendered dynamic directory headers, new-in-directory buttons and session rows cover grouping, search and propagation isolation. Local pagination is reached by actual wheel scrolling inside the recorded overview clip, including large text.
Long-list header reachability and search matching use deterministic fixture metadata.
Live cloud inventory refresh, remote session resume and concurrent service ordering require an authorized integration run.
Long directory-list fixtures assert section/header visibility in the containing sidebar. Shared section styling is not independently snapshot tested.
Rendered local session disclosure/search and continuation controls cover busy/uncertain/completed fixture states without real transfers.
Old account identities are rejected through the completion seam, not live concurrent service requests.
Actual remote continuation/transfer, service authentication and network acknowledgment are not exercised.
Fake refresh ordering and rendered loading/error transitions retain row bounds and scroll placement without live service requests.
Field/rotation models and a rendered touch target are tested. These establish numeric/input behavior, not the canvas paint output or GPU quality.
Canvas pixels, degenerate dimensions, clipping and animation smoothness lack dedicated visual assertions.

Rendered raw contacts verify cancellation without a jump, outside release, stale movement and competing-contact isolation. Pure paint orientation/scheduling tests verify motion preference and finite angles; no screenshot acceptance is implied.
Raw touch drives the rendered donut and asserts rotation updates without services.
Pointer delta and cancel behavior also has direct rotation-model regressions.
Native mouse capture outside the window and frame-by-frame rendering quality are not established by these fixture tests.
Raw touch drives the rendered donut and asserts rotation updates without services.
Pointer delta and cancel behavior also has direct rotation-model regressions.
Native mouse capture outside the window and frame-by-frame rendering quality are not established by these fixture tests.

Rendered raw contacts verify cancellation without a jump, outside release, stale movement and competing-contact isolation. Pure paint orientation/scheduling tests verify motion preference and finite angles; no screenshot acceptance is implied.

The orientation/frame-scheduling seam used by the wrapper canvas is checked for normal elapsed motion, bounded extreme inputs and static Reduce Motion baseline while explicit drag remains effective. This is not pixel comparison or direct frame-scheduler observation.
Smoothness, GPU appearance and native accessibility preference change delivery require visual/platform acceptance.
Field generation and smoothing have deterministic numeric assertions; they do not validate the final rendered animation pixel output.
Sign-in background rendering performance, visual quality and reduced-motion presentation need additional visual/device checks.
Application startup wiring registers native open-URL handling. Offline parser/dispatch tests intentionally avoid launching the Application or OS URL channel.
Inline parser regressions establish literal/delimiter text behavior used by this renderer; they are not pixel/style assertions for the inline UI helper.
Every rich-text style span, font metric and narrow wrapping combination is not independently rendered and asserted.
Phone transcript fixtures exercise rendered markdown bounds and parser tests preserve literal/code behavior. These are not exhaustive rendered-markdown snapshots.
Every markdown list/link/code combination and long-content visual branch still needs focused rendering evidence.
Bounded cache compares parsed structures and streaming invalidation, not pixels or every markdown rendering branch.
Phone transcript fixtures exercise rendered markdown bounds and parser tests preserve literal/code behavior. These are not exhaustive rendered-markdown snapshots.
Every markdown list/link/code combination and long-content visual branch still needs focused rendering evidence.
Reasoning fixture content is rendered in the constrained phone transcript. The assertion concerns bounds and width, not every reasoning formatting branch.
Collapsed/streaming/empty reasoning visual transitions and every rich-text branch lack exhaustive dedicated snapshots.
APNs/global push channel installation is intentionally excluded from fixtures. Native permission, entitlement and callback delivery require a device/service integration run.
Fake Token/Foreground/Open/Reply events exercise offline local state, active/parked routing, optimistic send/queue and deferred reply ownership without sockets or OS channels.
Real APNs delivery, token registration, badge clearing/reset and actual server receipt require native/service integration.
Keyboard mode/return-label state and app input focus have fixture coverage. These do not prove every rendered simulated key hit target.
Every viewport, gesture arbitration, app-field purpose/selection combination and native keyboard path remains outside the finite standalone and app-bridge fixtures.
UIKit keyboard/IME/autocorrect/system dictation behavior is outside the simulated keyboard and needs device checks.

Standalone rendered mouse-down key callbacks and reducer state are checked across letters/shift/symbol/email/number/code layouts, suggestion fills and blank-area focus/ancestor propagation. Fixed keyboard styling does not consume app text-scale/motion/appearance configuration, so matrix repetition is not visual accessibility proof. No native bridge or app text delivery is implied by this standalone fixture.

Actual rendered keyboard keys/suggestions and Return feed the real MobileApp focused TextInput bridge for composer, drawer search, directory, email/code, rename, transfer and Apple-link email fixtures. Unicode drafts remain field-local and blank keyboard taps preserve focus. Drawer layering is tested through actual key taps, not direct sim_key calls. Return intent is observed offline, not server/provider acknowledgement.
GPUI actions/platform-input methods and model invariants cover Unicode editing, submit, read-only selection/copy and configuration. Test-platform APIs do not prove UIKit.
Every multiline boundary, click count, registered action and simultaneous pointer/native selection route is not independently covered.

Rendered desktop pointer focus, Unicode drag selection, outside release then later drag, grapheme edits and field focus transfer are driven by real GPUI mouse/key events. This is not UIKit selection handles or every multiline/click/action combination.
Related fixtures focus auxiliary fields directly and exercise selection overlay controls. They are not direct proof of this mouse-down caret-placement handler.
Every multiline boundary, click count, registered action and simultaneous pointer/native selection route is not independently covered.

Rendered desktop pointer focus, Unicode drag selection, outside release then later drag, grapheme edits and field focus transfer are driven by real GPUI mouse/key events. This is not UIKit selection handles or every multiline/click/action combination.

Deterministic periodic integer ticks bound catch-up work after suspension and avoid f32 long-uptime stalls. Tests compare slow/fine advancement, huge/nonfinite/backward elapsed inputs, cycle thresholds and reduced-motion frame policy. No microphone/capture/services are initialized.
Narrow fixtures assert only rendered status bounds, not GPU pixels, all preview text clipping or native preference-change callbacks. Actual audio behavior is outside this autonomous simulation.

Pure-model tests cover phase instructions and bounded pull-sized semicircle geometry. The offline rendered fixture checks growth, microphone presence, idle absence and stable transcript bounds. These do not verify GPU pixels or real microphone capture.
Every visual phase, timing transition, accessibility label and small-screen overlay placement is not independently rendered/asserted.

scope: Production Rust module graph under src, both target branches. Counts are static syntax sites per owner, not runtime controls. Evidence is partial and gaps/platform requirements are explicit. Named test existence is checked separately from execution success.
